name: test
description: Run the workspace test suite (currently `bun test`) and return its output. Runs a single fixed command with no model-chosen arguments, no network, and no installs. A non-zero exit code (failing tests) is a normal result to read and iterate on, not an error.

timeoutSeconds.description: Optional timeout in seconds. Capped by the executor default tool timeout; a value above the cap is clamped to the cap.
